     * the call `str_first(buf + 1)` will dereference `s[0]`,

     *
     * When compiled with AddressSanitizer (e.g. -fsanitize=address)

    int v = str_first(buf + 1);  /* OOB read: s[0] reads past buf */
    (void)v;                     /* suppress unused‑variable warning */
    return 0;                    /* normal exit (never reached under ASAN) */
